brief: Evening in the temple library. On the low reading desk the half-burnt palm leaf glows gold. Smoke from a brass oil lamp curls upward and gathers into Dhūmaka, a small round smoke-grey ghost with big kind eyes, pointing at the leaf. You (seen from behind) and Dādī lean in; Śuka on your shoulder puffs his feathers in surprise.
